goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo (index.html, or index.html + engine3d.js + scene.js + app.js) with a Canvas 2D software 3D renderer on a full-viewport <canvas id="c">, dark radial-gradient space background, a two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel and crown cap (36 box faces), six orbiting octahedral crystals (48 triangles), a portal core with two counter-rotating rings, a cyber grid floor, 180 twinkling stars, 110 rising particles, an orbiting camera, and a glassmorphism HUD (NEON PORTAL 3D, FPS/POLYS/PARTS, Pause/Orbit ON/Reset buttons, speed slider).
verify_commands: test -f index.html && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),vm=require("vm");const h=fs.readFileSync("index.html","utf8");if(!/id=["'\'']c["'\'']/.test(h))throw new Error("missing canvas#c");for(const t of ["NEON PORTAL 3D","FPS","POLYS","PARTS","Pause","Orbit","Reset"])if(!h.includes(t))throw new Error("missing "+t);const srcs=[...h.matchAll(/<script[^>]*src=["'\'']([^"'\'']+)["'\''][^>]*>/gi)].map(m=>m[1]);for(const s of srcs){new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(s,"utf8"),{filename:s})}const inl=[...h.matchAll(/<script(?![^>]*\bsrc=)[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)].map(m=>m[1]);inl.forEach((c,i)=>new vm.Script(c,{filename:"inline-"+i+".js"}));if(!srcs.length&&!inl.length)throw new Error("no scripts");console.log("OK")'
constraints: Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> fills the browser window
Dark radial-gradient space background on the page or canvas
Zero external CDN or network dependencies
Software 3D renderer using Canvas 2D context without WebGL
3D perspective projection and camera/object rotation math
Backface culling and painter's algorithm depth sorting for polygons
Two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel, and crown cap built from 6 boxes (36 faces)
Six orbiting octahedral crystals totaling 48 triangles
Portal core with glowing neon energy effect
Two counter-rotating rings around the portal core
Cyber perspective grid floor rendered in 3D
110 rising neon particles in the scene
Orbiting camera that smoothly circles the portal
Glassmorphism HUD displaying NEON PORTAL 3D title
HUD displays live FPS, POLYS, and PARTS counters
Interactive Pause, Orbit ON/OFF, and Reset buttons
Interactive speed slider controlling animation speed
Valid JavaScript syntax in all inline or classic script files
